title: switch
summary: One value, many cases, and a default.

steps.title: switch
steps.say: When you're comparing **one** value against a list of exact options, `switch` is cleaner than a long if chain.

steps.title: break
steps.say: With `return` each case leaves the method. Without it, cases fall through into the next one, so you end them with `break`.

marks.label: stop here, don't run the next case

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: It may be further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `public static String driveModeName` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find public static String driveModeName with Ctrl+F.
